title: Door quota and classify concurrency are pooled per registry tenant, which every personal workspace shares
body:
Found while fixing #11186.

`crates/gateway/src/serve.rs` reserves door quota in the quota ledger by `caller.tenant` (`reserved`, `quota::Call { tenant, .. }`), and the classify concurrency pools (`tenant_classify_inputs`, `tenant_classify_in_flight`) are keyed by tenant too. Every personal workspace made by sign-up is bound to the one tenant `signup`, so all signed-up people share one door quota and one classify concurrency budget: one heavy caller can exhaust everyone's.

No secret or person's data leaks (the receipts and jobs are already keyed by the key id), so #11186 left this out. Fix: reserve quota and pick the pool by the workspace the key acts in (`inference_public::key_scope`), keeping the tenant's manifest quota as the per-workspace allowance, or give sign-up its own per-workspace quota policy; extend `accounts_on_one_tenant_never_see_or_use_each_others_keys_or_state` with a door call.
